meta.name: add-linear
meta.description: Add Linear channel integration via Chat SDK. Issue comment threads as conversations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 Linear 工单评论转为聊天会话
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果团队用 Linear 管理任务并希望直接在聊天中跟进评论。
copy.tagline_en: Turn Linear issue comments into chat conversations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team uses Linear for task management and wants to follow up comments in chat.

howto.what: agent 会通过 Chat SDK 接入 Linear,自动监听指定团队所有 issue 的评论。每条评论(包括别人的)都会触发 agent 自动回复,无需 @提及;每个 issue 的评论线程作为一个独立对话,首次回复时会打招呼。
howto.when: 当被监控的 Linear 团队中任何 issue 出现新评论时触发(webhook 驱动,无需 @ 提及)。若使用 Personal API key,来自你自己的评论会被过滤,不触发。

say.text: 请分析这个 issue 的报错原因。
say.note: agent 会读取线程上下文并给出回答。

say.text: 这个方案有什么潜在风险?
say.note: agent 会基于讨论内容回复。

say.text: 请给一个可执行的修复步骤。
say.note: agent 会结合评论给出步骤。

howto.what_en: The agent integrates Linear via Chat SDK: it watches all issue comments in the chosen team, responds to every comment without @mentions, treats each issue thread as its own conversation, and greets on first reply.
howto.when_en: Triggers on any new comment on an issue in the monitored Linear team (webhook-driven, no @mention required). With a Personal API key, your own comments are filtered out and won't trigger.

say_en.text: Please analyze the cause of this issue's error.
say_en.note: The agent reads the thread and replies.

say_en.text: What are the potential risks of this approach?
say_en.note: The agent answers based on the discussion.
The agent provides steps from the comments.
